Which upstream failures become which tagged errors?
decisions.answer: GitConstructError <- instanceof GitConstructError; GitPluginError <- instanceof GitPluginError; GitResponseError <- instanceof GitResponseError; TaskConfigurationError <- instanceof TaskConfigurationError; GitError <- instanceof GitError; SimpleGitError
decisions.why: exported error classes, most specific first, then the catch-all SimpleGitError carrying `code` (the source sets EPIPE, ERROR)
